entry.name: mc.number~
entry.digest: Multichannel signal monitor and constant generator
entry.description: Use the mc.number~ object to display or generate multichannel signal values.

attributes.digest: Fixed channel count
attributes.description: When the value ofis non-zero theobject displays and outputs a fixed number of channels regardless of the number of channels in a connected multichannel signal. Whenis 0 (the default), the object auto-adapts to the channel count of the connected multichannel signal.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Click on the icon at the left side ofto switch between(wave) and(arrow). When in signal output mode, click on the number to highlight it for typing. Scroll on the number to change it. In either mode, click the dots below the number to choose a channel value to display.

messages.name: allow
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets what display modes can be used.restrictsto signal output display mode.restrictsto input monitor display mode.(the default) premits the use of both modes, and lets you click on the icon at the left side of the object to switch between them.

messages.name: flags
messages.description: Themessage is provided for legacy support of theobject; all the original functionality is now provided by object attributes.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: The value becomes a constant signal for the currently displayed channel in the multichannel output. Whenis in signal output mode, the value is displayed. If the ramp time is non-zero, the output signal will ramp between its previous value and the newly set value.In right inlet: Sets a ramp time in milliseconds. The default time is 0.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets a ramp time in milliseconds. The default time is 0.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set a signal value and ramp time
messages.description: The first number sets a constant value for the output signal (see themessage above for details), and the second number sets the ramp time in milliseconds.

messages.name: max
messages.description: The word, followed by an optional number, sets the maximum value offor signal output. The wordwith no arguments clears any previously set maximum value.

messages.name: min
messages.description: The word, followed by an optional number, sets the minimum value offor signal output. The wordwith no arguments clears any previously set minimum value.

messages.name: mode
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, sets the current display mode, if it is currently allowed (see themessage).sets signal output mode.sets signal input monitor mode.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Display a number without causing output
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a number sets theobject to display that number in signal output mode without causing output.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Multichannel signal input to be displayed and input
messages.description: samples values from a connected multichannel signal at a rate specified by itsattribute. Sampled values are sent out the middle outlet, preceded by a channel index out the right outlet. Whenis in, it displays sampled values for the currently selected display channel.

outlets.digest: Entered or received float values as a multichannel signal
